result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: HDI defends and indemnifies the Company and its affiliates against third-party claims involving HDI-provided IP, breach of law, HDI-caused data incidents, and gross negligence or wilful misconduct, with notice, defense control, settlement protection, and cooperation mechanics. No Customer indemnity is added, which is no broader than the permitted Customer indemnity and avoids an unnecessary concession. The change otherwise leaves the agreement intact. Drafting quality is reduced because the clause appears after the Section 10 heading and is labeled subsection (c), while the comment states it was placed in Section 9; that numbering/location inconsistency should be corrected, particularly if survival depends on placement in Section 9.
